> 封印物厄运物（第1页）
风暴之心产地：诡秘之主类型：封印物特殊装备品质：特殊装备效果1，海之灾（被动）：当处于海域时，消耗3000点生命值并将心脏放置在火焰上，可在该区域唤出大型的海难。
装备效果2，深海呼唤（主动）：捏碎心脏，并将心脏投入大海后，可召唤出掩藏在灵界的‘幽灵战船’供你驱使。
（若不在‘诡秘之主’世界，召唤战船将需额外消耗不定量的灵魂钱币。
）提示：非‘暴君’途径的非凡者携带此物品时，将不定时受到‘雷击’，且若处于阴雨天，或海域时，‘雷击’的几率将大幅度提升。
简介：火山，海难，雷鸣，风灾，我们是上帝的代罚者。
灵梦之眼产地：诡秘之主类型：封印物符文宝石品质：特殊装备效果1，梦境投影（主动）：消耗500~3500点魔法值，可将自身或他人的梦境，进行投影具现，并根据精神强度，。
装备效果2，入梦（被动）：当镶嵌在‘首饰类’装备上时，可在静茹‘梦境’类世界时，额外获得一件装备位。
提示：携带此装备，将不定时进入‘梦境’陷入沉睡，且无视任何判定效果。
（自身裸装意志力大于150点后，可免疫此效果）简介：黑夜女神，绝不会饶恕你，叛徒，必须死！
愤怒之印产地:诡秘之主类型:封印物特殊装备品质:特殊效果:释放后，真实力量+3，真实敏捷+3，真实智力-1，真实魅力-5，持续3分钟，冷却时间12小时。
提示:携带此物品，将常常感到愤怒和焦虑，有一定几率进入‘失控’状态，简介:杂糅了数位非凡特性的产物。
蟾鸣雕像类型：次级厄运物品质：特殊携带效果：以任何方式持有，接触，查探此物品时，都将聆听‘撒托古亚’的蟾鸣，并对意志力判定。
若长期持有，将持续消耗精神力和自身运势。
提示:意志力低于51（提升1点）的目标，将被立即转化成为污染源，拥有‘污染’能力，（被污染转化的目标，将成为次级污染物）并成为‘撒托古亚’的信徒。
提示:持有者可无限制操控由此雕像转化的‘污染物’和‘次级污染物’。
祭祀效果1：由此雕像转化的教徒，每次转化当作为古神媒介使用时，将必定获得‘撒托古亚’的回应。
提示:次级污染物越多，雕像可收获的信仰之力也将越多，自身效果也将越强。
）提示（新增）:信仰之力每提升1000点，都将永久强化‘携带效果’。

（当前信仰之力1034点）破坏代价:将遭受一次来自‘古神撒托古亚’的意志侵袭，并将永久遭受‘无形之子’和‘沃米人’的种族追杀。
简介：教派的建立将从传播污染开始，当信仰之力达到满值时，你将获得古神的恩赐。

> Sealed Artifacts of Doom (Page 1)
Heart of the Storm Origin: Lord of Mysteries Type: Sealed Object Special Equipment Quality: Special Equipment Effect 1, Sea Disaster (Passive): When in the sea, consume 3000 health points and place the heart on the flame to summon a large shipwreck in the area.
Equipment effect 2, Call of the Deep Sea (active): After crushing the heart and throwing it into the sea, a "ghost warship" hidden in the spiritual world can be summoned for you to drive.
(If you are not in the world of 'Lord of Mysteries', summoning a warship will require an extra amount of soul coins.
) Tip: When Extraordinaries of the non-Tyrant path carry this item, they will be struck by lightning from time to time, and if it is in rainy days or in the sea, the chance of being struck by lightning will be greatly increased.
Introduction: Volcanoes, shipwrecks, thunder, and wind disasters, we are God’s punishment.
Eye of Reimu Origin: Lord of Mysteries Type: Sealed Object Rune Gemstone Quality: Special Equipment Effect 1, Dream Projection (Active): It consumes 500~3500 magic points to project your own or other people's dreams and manifest them according to your mental strength.
Equipment effect 2, dreaming (passive): When embedded in 'jewelry' type equipment, you can get an additional equipment slot in Jingru's 'dream' type world.
Tips: Carrying this equipment will cause you to enter the 'Dream Realm' from time to time and fall into a deep sleep, regardless of any judgment effects.
(You can be immune to this effect if your naked willpower is greater than 150 points) Introduction: The goddess of the night will never forgive you, you traitor must die!
Seal of Wrath Origin: Lord of Mysteries Type: Sealed Object Special Equipment Quality: Special Effect: After release, true power +3, true agility +3, true intelligence -1, true charm -5, lasts 3 minutes, cooling time is 12 hours.
Tips: If you carry this item, you will often feel angry and anxious, and there is a certain chance of entering a state of 'out of control'. Introduction: A product that is a mixture of digital extraordinary properties.
Toad-Crying Statue Type: Secondary Bad Luck Object Quality: Special Carrying Effect: When holding, touching, or inspecting this item in any way, the toad-crying of 'Satogua' will be heard and the willpower will be judged.
If you hold it for a long time, it will continue to consume your mental energy and your own luck.
Tips: Targets whose willpower is lower than 51 (raised by 1 point) will be immediately transformed into sources of pollution, possessing the ability to 'pollute' (targets transformed by pollution will become secondary pollutants) and become followers of 'Sathogya'.
Tip: The holder has unlimited control over the 'pollutants' and 'secondary pollutants' transformed by this statue.
Sacrifice effect 1: The believers transformed by this statue will definitely receive the response of ‘Tsatogua’ every time they are transformed and used as a medium for the ancient gods.
Tip: The more secondary pollutants there are, the more power of faith the statue can harvest, and the stronger its own effect will be.
) Tips (newly added): Every 1,000-point increase in the power of faith will permanently strengthen the ‘carrying effect’.
(Current power of faith: 1034 points) Cost of destruction: You will be invaded by the will of the 'Ancient God Tsathogua', and you will be permanently hunted by the races of the 'Invisible Sons' and the 'Womi'.
Introduction: The establishment of a sect will start by spreading pollution. When the power of faith reaches full value, you will receive the gift of the ancient god.
